title: Painted Chest
summary: Portable painted chest. A locked sewer example opens with the Painted Key.

fields.Use: Pick up, throw, or use it as a container. Loot varies. The sewer example can be lockpicked at DC 20 and contains gold, random common armour and possible arrows or a scroll.
fields.Object defences: 50 HP, Sturdy. Vulnerable to Bludgeoning, resistant to Piercing, Necrotic and Radiant, immune to Poison and Psychic.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
